text: bojjhaṅgā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti yathayidaṃ bhikkhave yoniso manasikāro yoniso bhikkhave manasikaroto anuppannā ceva bojjhaṅgā uppajjanti uppannā ca bojjhaṅgā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchantīti . [77] appamattikā esā bhikkhave parihāni yadidaṃ ñāti parihāni etaṃ paṭikiṭṭhaṃ bhikkhave parihānīnaṃ yadidaṃ paññāparihānīti .
